name: Hinata Online - Le jeu !
source:
You are the hero of the story, in which, as a member of the site, will be able to join us in Tokyo to celebrate with us this big birthday party !

But be careful because Tokyo is a big city and it is not easy to get around without a good guide ...

Discover the members of the Staff blog and forum in an adventure where your sense of direction will be put to the test!

Explore every corner of Tokyo to get both ends of the game!

[From [url=https://akamis.itch.io/hinata-online-le-jeu] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是故事的主人公，作为网站的会员，将能够与我们一起在东京与我们一起庆祝这个盛大的生日聚会！

但要小心，因为东京是一个大城市，如果没有好的导游，出行并不容易……

在冒险中探索员工博客和论坛的成员，你的方向感将受到考验！

探索东京的每一个角落，获得游戏的两端！

[来自[url=https://akamis.itch.io/hinata-online-le-jeu] itch.io[/url]]
